newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price - USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Friday that around 3,000 head were exported into the United States at three crossing points Thursday.
Through Santa Teresa, New Mexico, around 1,600 steer calves were sold, although not enough to establish quote prices.
"Around 90 percent of supply were sold on video, previously contracted or retained by owners," USDA said.
Through Presidio, Texas, around 1,200 head were sold at steady prices compared to Wednesday.
"Trade moderate, demand good. Bulk of supply consisted of steers weighing 300-500 lb," the USDA said.
Prices for head weighing 300-400 lb were 94-104 cents/lb and for 400-500 lb head at 84-94 cents/lb.
Through Laredo, Texas, around 200 head were sold, although not enough to establish market trend prices.
